description: Synthetic golden set (24 messages, 3 per intent) for smoke-testing the eval harness. All bodies are original synthetic text written for a health & wellness coaching company's setter inbox. Replace/augment with real labeled messages mined from Close Conversations (see eval/README.md) before trusting accuracy numbers.

messages.body: Hi! I came across your coaching program online and I'd love to talk to someone about it. Do you have any openings for an intro call this week?
messages.notes: First-time prospect asking to book an intro call.

messages.body: Hello, I'm interested in the weight-loss coaching plan. Could I schedule a consultation for Tuesday or Thursday afternoon next week? Let me know what times you have.
messages.notes: Email lead proposing specific days for a consultation.

messages.body: Hey this is Dana, my friend raves about you guys. How do I book my first call to get started?
messages.notes: Referral asking how to book a first call.

messages.body: Hi, I have a call booked tomorrow at 3pm but work just scheduled over it. Can we move it to Thursday afternoon instead?
messages.notes: Existing booking needs to move to a new day.

messages.body: I need to reschedule my Friday appointment, a family emergency came up. Would Monday morning work instead? Sorry for the short notice.
messages.notes: Explicit reschedule request with a proposed alternative.

messages.body: Running about 20 minutes late, can we push my call back half an hour? Stuck in traffic.
messages.notes: Same-day delay; wants the call pushed back.

messages.body: Hey coach, logged my meals today, right around 1800 calories and hit my protein target. Down 2 lbs this week, feeling good!
messages.notes: Client food log / progress update, no action requested.

messages.body: Quick question on the meal plan: can I swap the chicken for salmon at dinner? Also, should I take the magnesium before bed or in the morning?
messages.notes: Program question from an active client.

messages.body: Do I take the pre-workout on rest days too? The label is confusing and I don't want to mess up the plan.
messages.notes: Supplement question from an active client.

messages.body: I was charged twice this month, there are two $297 charges on my card. Please refund the duplicate, that's not right.
messages.notes: Duplicate charge, explicitly asks for a refund.

messages.body: I'd like a refund for last week's payment. The program isn't what I expected and honestly I haven't even started it yet.
messages.notes: Refund request, dissatisfied before starting.

messages.body: You took payment after I already cancelled. I want my money back, please reverse the charge today.
messages.notes: Charge after cancellation, demands reversal.

messages.body: Please cancel my membership effective immediately. Money's tight right now and I can't keep paying for this.
messages.notes: Direct cancellation request, financial reason.

messages.body: I need to cancel my coaching plan, I'm moving out of state next month and won't be able to continue. What do I need to do?
messages.notes: Cancellation request asking about the process.

messages.body: Cancel my subscription please. Not using it anymore.
messages.notes: Terse subscription cancellation.

messages.body: I can't log into the app, it keeps saying my password is wrong even though I just reset it. Can someone help?
messages.notes: Login/access problem.

messages.body: The week 3 training video won't load for me. Tried on my phone and my laptop, just a black screen. Everything else works fine.
messages.notes: Content playback issue across devices.

messages.body: Your booking link seems broken, the page just spins and never shows the calendar. Tried twice.
messages.notes: Broken booking link; a tech issue, not a booking request.

messages.body: STOP
messages.notes: Canonical SMS opt-out keyword.

messages.body: Stop texting me. Unsubscribe.
messages.notes: Plain-language opt-out.

messages.body: Please take me off your list, I don't want to get these messages anymore.
messages.notes: Polite opt-out phrasing.

messages.body: Sorry, wrong number, I think you've got the wrong person.
messages.notes: Wrong-number chatter; not a setter intent.

messages.body: Do you offer a referral bonus? My sister has been asking about coaching and I told her about you.
messages.notes: Referral-program question; not in the taxonomy.

messages.body: Thanks! Have a great weekend!
messages.notes: Generic pleasantry; no actionable intent.
